name: Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)
body:
> Hub · Summit Az · 2026-10-22

Summit Plumbing Pros is a residential plumber based in Mesa, Arizona (ROC #338366) serving 10 East Valley and Phoenix-area cities from summitplumbingpros.com. TAG's work covers technical SEO, Rank Math on-page SEO, city and service page rewrites, blogs, schema, indexing and reporting. Owner side is Scott; Kim runs the work and approvals. This is the ARIZONA site only. The Utah company (summitplumbingut.com) is a separate property; the one Utah file in this folder is clearly labeled.
